sg-regs-2005-reg5.label: Special Guardianship Regulations 2005, reg 5
sg-regs-2005-reg5.holding: The council remains responsible for assessing support needs for three years from the making of the order.

sg-regs-2005-reg9.label: Special Guardianship Regulations 2005, reg 9
sg-regs-2005-reg9.holding: Financial support ceases in the circumstances set out in the regulation, including when the child reaches 18 unless the conditions for continuing are met.

sg-regs-2005-reg10-11.label: Special Guardianship Regulations 2005, regs 10-11
sg-regs-2005-reg10-11.holding: Financial support is subject to annual review, and the council must notify the special guardian of any proposed variation.

dfe-guidance-2017-para65.label: DfE Special Guardianship Guidance (Jan 2017), para 65
dfe-guidance-2017-para65.note: Under review - updated guidance expected Summer 2026 after the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026.

lewisham-2008.label: R (B) v Lewisham LBC [2008] EWHC 738 (Admin)
lewisham-2008.holding: Using the lower adoption allowance model was unlawful. Fostering allowances are the starting point.

kirklees-2010.label: Barrett v Kirklees MBC [2010] EWHC 467 (Admin)
kirklees-2010.holding: A flat two-thirds of the core fostering allowance was an unjustified departure from guidance.

merton-2012.label: R (TT) v Merton LBC [2012] EWHC 2055 (Admin)
merton-2012.holding: Blanket percentage deduction unlawful. BUT: no duty to pay every special guardian an allowance, and the means-test methodology itself was upheld as lawful.

tower-hamlets-2013.label: R (X) v Tower Hamlets LBC [2013] EWCA Civ 904
tower-hamlets-2013.holding: Paying family foster carers less than unrelated foster carers was unlawful. Former foster carers should not be worse off.

lgsco-devon-2024.label: LGSCO decision, Devon County Council (2024)
lgsco-devon-2024.holding: Blanket Child Benefit deduction including from carers on means-tested benefits was unlawful.

lgsco-southend-2020.label: LGSCO decision, Southend-on-Sea (Dec 2020)
lgsco-southend-2020.holding: Tapering the whole allowance to 75% then 50% misapplied reg 7, which covers only the reward element.

lgsco-north-tyneside-17002928.label: LGSCO decision, North Tyneside Council (17 002 928)
lgsco-north-tyneside-17002928.holding: A fixed-percentage special guardianship allowance policy was unlawful; backdating was ordered.

corambaaf-pn75.label: CoramBAAF Practice Note 75 - special guardianship financial support
corambaaf-pn75.holding: The DfE standardised means-test model is non-statutory and pre-dates Universal Credit.

dfe-nma-2026-27.label: DfE National Minimum Allowance for foster carers, 2026 to 2027

dfe-nma-2025-26.label: DfE National Minimum Allowance for foster carers, 2025 to 2026

wg-nma-2026-27.label: Welsh Government National Minimum Allowance, 2026 to 2027

sra-2026-27.label: Scottish Recommended Allowance, 2026 to 2027
sra-2026-27.holding: A national minimum for foster and kinship carers alike. Councils may pay more.

cb-ga-uprating-order-2026.label: Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance Up-rating Order 2026

cb-ga-uprating-order-2025.label: Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance Up-rating Order 2025

uc-two-child-limit-act-2026.label: Universal Credit (Removal of Two Child Limit) Act 2026 c.13

kinship-zones-2026.label: Kinship Zones - kinship allowance pilot (2026-2029)
kinship-zones-2026.holding: A pilot in seven English councils paying a non-means-tested allowance equal to the fostering National Minimum Allowance.
